cd /private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-host-2/workspace/task && python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('scratch/measurements.json',encoding='utf-8'))
v=[r['value'] for r in d if isinstance(r.get('value'),(int,float)) and not isinstance(r.get('value'),bool) and 10<=r['value']<20]
out={'count':len(v),'sum':sum(v)}
open('scratch/stats.json','w',encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(out)
" && cat scratch/stats.json && md5 scratch/measurements.json
